traditional: the Moon opposition Venus: a hard contact. The body, home, and daily needs works against love, money, and pleasure - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet charm and pleasure. Warmth is expressed instinctively, with a strong love of comfort and beauty. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Feelings expressed erratically, a tendency to overspend or overindulge, and feeling unliked without cause. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.summary: Keeping everyone happy stops being generous when you are the one quietly paying for it with your time, money, comfort, or energy.
readerCopy.body: Keeping everyone happy stops being generous when you are the one quietly paying for it with your time, money, comfort, or energy. When the Moon opposes Venus, harmony and affection can come into conflict with needs that have been ignored to preserve the pleasant plan. Put the private cost into the conversation. A compromise is not balanced if one person keeps absorbing the inconvenience so nobody else has to feel disappointed.
